android.desc:
Say goodbye to endless scrolling and ghosted messages. Nearnook is the hyper-local marketplace built for speed. Buy, sell, and explore your city's secondhand market in stunning, real-time 3D, making buying and selling feel like a video game rather than a chore.

Whether you're looking to declutter your apartment, find vintage thrift store gems, or pick up used furniture, Nearnook turns your neighborhood into an interactive digital world.

EXPLORE IN 3D Ditch the boring grids. Walk through a virtual, gamified version of your city to discover local items for sale right around the corner.

GIVE & FIND FREE STUFF Keep items out of landfills and support your community. Easily list items to give away for free, or find local treasures up for grabs in your neighborhood at zero cost.

TRUSTED PET ADOPTION Find your new best friend safely. To protect animal welfare and prevent scams, only verified, registered UK rescue centers are permitted to list pets for adoption on Nearnook.

BUILT FOR SPEED No more waiting days for a reply. Nearnook is designed for lightning-fast chats and instant negotiations so you can make deals and meet up faster than ever.

HYPER-LOCAL DISCOVERY Find exactly what you're looking for without the commute. Filter items by walking distance, neighborhood, or specific radius.

BUY, SELL & THRIFT

Sell: Snap a pic, set a price, and drop your item into the 3D map in seconds.
Buy: Hunt for deals on electronics, clothing, furniture, games, and more.
SAFE & SECURE TRADING Trade with confidence using verified user profiles, community ratings, and secure in-app messaging.

Ready to level up how you buy, sell, and support your community locally? Download Nearnook today and step into the future of the secondhand marketplace!

quotes.title: I built a local 3D marketplace with pizza-style tracking in Flutter
